comment: `rewrites` replaces the older `routes` block: Vercel forbids using both, and only the
newer form can rewrite to an EXTERNAL host, which /admin needs — the admin panel is a
separate Firebase Hosting project. Rewrites run only after the filesystem misses, so the
`handle: filesystem` step the routes block used is now implicit.
Order matters: /admin is claimed before the SPA catch-all, or React Router would swallow
it and render a 404 page instead.
